blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson on Friday called out what he described as continued “illegal reclamation” on the Taguig side of Laguna Lake. He made the revelation as he shared a video taken during a joint government inspection of the area. Lacson called on the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) and Laguna Lake Development Authority (LLDA) in his post. He described what was seen during the inspection as a “total display of impunity and disrespect for the law.” The 25-second video showed members of a joint inspection team from the Office of the Ombudsman, Philippine Reclamation Authority […]...
